stations.title: Fill 250 mL
stations.does: Fill one 250 mL bottle with thick body lotion using a timed/volumetric fill (about 5 seconds per bottle).

stations.title: Place pump head
stations.does: Place the pump head onto the bottle opening/neck position.

stations.title: Screw-down pump
stations.does: Screw the pump head down to secure it (screw-down operation).

stations.title: Apply front label
stations.does: Apply a front label to the bottle.

stations.title: Weigh + camera inspection
stations.does: Weigh the filled-and-labeled bottle and perform camera inspection; compare against acceptance limits.

stations.title: Remove rejected bottles
stations.does: Remove any rejected bottles from the line.

stations.title: Pack 12 per case
stations.does: Pack finished, accepted bottles into cases with 12 bottles per case.

notes: Takt is 12 s/unit (300/h). All station budgets are set to be ≤12 s so the line runs at the slowest station without falling behind.
Packing “12 per case” is handled by a case packer that indexes/positions cases and bottles; this is budgeted as 8 s per bottle to keep the overall takt.
Clean-room requirement is assumed to be satisfied by enclosing ST1–ST5 and using sealed conveyors/tunnels; operators only at end-of-line after ST6 (consistent with your constraint).
